name: What is the difference between a primary suite addition and a primary bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a primary suite addition and a primary bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A primary suite addition involves building new square footage onto your home to create an entirely new primary bedroom and bathroom space, along with potentially other amenities like a walk-in closet. This expands the home's footprint and total living area. In contrast, a primary bathroom remodel focuses on renovating and updating an existing bathroom within the current footprint of your home. While a remodel can significantly upgrade the look and functionality of a bathroom, it does not add new space or increase the overall square footage of the house.
acceptedAnswer.description: A primary suite addition builds new space, expanding the home's footprint, while a primary bathroom remodel updates an existing bathroom within its current space.
